subject.name: Computer Science
subject.description: Computer Science syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: Topic 5: Cyber Security
topics.description: This topic introduces learners to the fundamentals of cybersecurity and the importance of safeguarding digital systems and personal data. It covers common cyber threats and safe online practices to promote responsible behavior in a digital environment.

sub_topics.name: Sub Topic 1.5.1 Fundamentals of cyber security
sub_topics.description: Introduces core principles of cyber security, key concepts, common threats, preventive strategies, and responsible online behavior.

competencies.description: Apply online safety and security measures

topics.name: Topic 6: Data Processing
topics.description: Focuses on equipping learners with skills to collect and clean data effectively, enabling them to retrieve, transform, and classify data into usable forms for real-world applications.

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic: 1.6.1 Data Collection and Cleaning
sub_topics.description: Covers gathering data from reliable sources and cleaning it by correcting errors, removing duplicates, and ensuring consistency for effective decision-making.

topics.name: Topic 7: Web Design
topics.description: Introduces the basics of web design, focusing on how websites are structured using HTML and other tools to create well-organized web pages following modern standards.

sub_topics.name: Sub – Topic: 1.7. 1 Fundamentals of Web Design
sub_topics.description: Explores basic web design principles, HTML structure, essential web components, and the roles of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

competencies.description: Design and Structure Web Pages using web design tools

topics.name: TOPIC 8: Digital Citizenship
topics.description: Introduces digital citizenship, covering respectful online communication, evaluating information reliability, managing screen time, and promoting fairness in digital communities.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic: 1.8.1 Digital Ethics
sub_topics.description: Focuses on responsible technology use, online safety, privacy, addressing cyberbullying, digital footprints, and maintaining digital health.

competencies.description: Demonstrate Ethical Behavior in a Digital Environment

topics.name: Topic 9: Databases
topics.description: This topic introduces learners to the basics of databases, focusing on how data is stored, organized, and managed in computer systems. It highlights the importance of databases in real-world applications and provides practical skills in creating and managing simple databases using common database management systems (DBMS). The topic serves as a foundation for advanced learning in areas such as database design, SQL programming, and application integration

sub_topics.name: 1.9.1 Introduction to Databases
sub_topics.description: This topic introduces learners to the basics of databases, including key concepts like tables, records, and fields. It covers types of databases, common DBMS tools (Access, Oracle), and involves practical tasks to help students create and manage simple databases—building essential skills for future learning and real-world use

topics.name: Topic 10: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
topics.description: This topic introduces learners to the foundational concepts of Artificial Intelligence (AI), emphasizing its principles and societal impact. It aims to foster an understanding of AI’s role in daily life and its ethical implications, preparing learners for advanced exploration in subsequent years.

competencies.description: Use AI applications in everyday life
Advocate for ethical AI practices and address potential risks.

sub_topics.name: Sub-Topic 1.10.1 Fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence
sub_topics.description: This subtopic introduces learners to the basics of Artificial Intelligence (AI), showing how machines can learn from data and make decisions. Learners will explore real-life examples and discover how AI is used in fields like healthcare, education, and agriculture, while also considering its benefits and challenges in society

topics.name: Topic 11: Internet of Things (IoT)
topics.description: This Topic introduces learners to the basic concepts and components of IoT systems, fostering an understanding of how these technologies are integrated into daily life. The focus is on identifying and understanding the roles of key IoT components such as sensors, actuators, microcontrollers, and communication modules.

competencies.description: Analyze IoT components and their functions in interconnected systems.
Apply foundational knowledge of IoT to solve simple real-world problems.

sub_topics.name: Subtopic 1.11.1 Basic Components of Internet of Things (IoT)
sub_topics.description: This subtopic introduces learners to the Internet of Things (IoT). IoT is a network of physical devices, such as appliances, vehicles, or sensors, embedded with electronics, software, and connectivity to collect and exchange data over the internet. IoT enables automation, efficiency, and innovation in applications like smart homes, healthcare, agriculture, and industrial systems. These components form the foundation of IoT systems, enabling devices to sense, process, act, and communicate.

topics.name: Topic 12: Logic Gates
topics.description: This topic introduces learners to logic gates as basic building blocks of digital systems that process binary inputs to produce outputs. Learners will explore various types of gates (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR) and their practical applications in digital circuits such as computers, alarms, and traffic lights. Emphasis is placed on understanding how logic gates contribute to the efficiency, functionality, and security of digital technologies, forming a foundation for further study in electronics and system design.

competencies.description: Design circuits, and applying them to solve real-world problems.

sub_topics.name: Sub-topic 1.12.1 Digital Control Systems
sub_topics.description: Focuses on analyzing logic gate concepts, truth tables, and creating digital control systems such as alarms and traffic lights.
